obligations.expected_behavior: A Skill designated as local-only explicitly declares that external API/version lookup is not applicable.
forbidden_result: The local-only Skill omits the declaration.
The Skill states or implies that external API/version lookup is applicable.
obligations.observable_result: The Skill's metadata or validation contract records external API/version lookup as not applicable.
obligations.state_after: The local-only Skill explicitly records external API/version lookup as not applicable.
obligations.state_before: A Skill is designated local-only, but applicability of external API/version lookup is not yet established.
obligations.subject: Local-only Skill declaration
obligations.trigger: When a Skill is designated local-only.

obligations.expected_behavior: A local-only Skill validates without using Context7, an MCP connection, or network access.
forbidden_result: Validation requires or establishes a Context7 dependency.
Validation requires or establishes an MCP connection.
Validation requires or establishes network access.
obligations.observable_result: Validation completes successfully with Context7 unavailable, no MCP connection, and no network access.
obligations.state_after: The local-only Skill has validated in an environment without Context7, an MCP connection, or network access.
obligations.state_before: The local-only Skill is awaiting validation under local-only execution constraints.
obligations.subject: Local-only Skill validation boundary
obligations.trigger: When validating a Skill declared local-only.

obligations.expected_behavior: A local fixture with no network configuration passes validation.
forbidden_result: The local fixture fails validation solely because it lacks network configuration.
The fixture is treated as requiring external connectivity.
obligations.observable_result: The local fixture without network configuration receives a passing validation result.
obligations.state_after: The network-free local fixture is accepted by validation.
obligations.state_before: A local fixture has no network configuration and is submitted for validation.
obligations.subject: Local fixture validation
obligations.trigger: When a local fixture without network configuration is validated.

obligations.expected_behavior: Validation fails when a Skill is falsely declared local-only while declaring a network or API dependency.
forbidden_result: The falsely declared local-only Skill passes validation.
A declared network/API dependency is ignored or treated as compatible with local-only status.
obligations.observable_result: The validation result is a failure for a local-only declaration that includes a network or API dependency.
obligations.state_after: The contradictory local-only declaration is rejected with a failing validation result.
obligations.state_before: A Skill is declared local-only while also declaring a network or API dependency.
obligations.subject: Contradictory local-only declaration
